task_text: Follow the directive **"put the soap dispenser to the right of the boxed food"**. Directions are as the arms face the table: left = +y, right = -y, behind = +x (farther from the arms), in front = -x (nearer to them). Success: measured from the boxed food's centre (wherever it is at that moment), the soap dispenser's centre lies 0.06-0.30 m to the right of it (along that direction) and within 0.08 m of that line sideways, and no more than 0.03 m higher than where the soap dispenser started (so it is set down, not held up). The goal must hold for 30 consecutive control steps (1.02 s); the episode then ends in success.
